title: SilkCoin Developers Announce "Biodegradable Blockchain" - Network Already Decomposing
body: The eco-friendly blockchain is working as intended, say developers. Users report transactions "composting" before confirmation.
summary: SilkCoin's green blockchain initiative is working too well -- transactions are disappearing.

comments.content: Sold all my COB at -94% to buy savings bonds. My husband says I have no vision but at least I can afford socks now.
